_help: Zombie variants (all share the UAL2 skeleton + clips). model_height = the model's real height in metres (auto-scale target, so nothing gets shrunk). health/speed/damage multipliers stack on top of main.gd's per-round stats. wave_mix: the entry with the highest from_round <= current round is used; weights are relative. Special variants ("special": true: bloated / crawler / riot) carry a behaviour "script" (extends enemy.gd, swapped in by ZombieVariants.apply_script, MAIN_HOOKS §15a) and "behavior" knobs; they are not in wave_mix: data/difficulty.json profiles[].variants.specials adds them per round (Difficulty.variant_weights). "runner": false = never gets main.gd's 25% runner speed bonus.

behavior._help: Death burst from BurstPoint. windup s (Zombie_BurstWindup) unless melee-killed or killed within instant_range m of the player. burst_radius m; player takes contact_damage x player_damage_mult (capped per burst at difficulty.json variants.bloater_burst_player_cap, else player_damage_cap), zombies take max_health x zombie_damage_frac (both fall off to 30% at the edge, like Explosion). Puddle: puddle_radius m, puddle_time s, puddle_slow = player speed -45%. Pustules: pustule_hits bullet hits within pustule_hit_radius m of BurstPoint hide them; the burst (radius, damage) then x popped_mult and the puddle x0.75.

Own body: collision capsule (radius/height/center_y m) and bar_height m for the health bar. Ankle grab: lunge (Zombie_AnkleGrab) when the player is within grab_range m; after grip_delay s it holds if still within grip_range m: player rooted, drain_per_sec HP for up to grab_time s. Jump / melee swing / kill frees; grab_cooldown s between grabs.

Frontal cone_deg cone: hits lose reduction (0.8 = 80%) of their damage, headshots included, until the armour (armor_frac x max_health HP, worn down by what it absorbs) breaks (Zombie_ArmorBreak, armor_nodes hidden). Back / side hits: full damage. Explosives ignore pierce_explosive and burn ticks pierce_burn of the reduction (burn: any side). Hits below leg_height m wear leg_frac of the armour HP off the legs and hide ArmorLegs (cosmetic). Attacker mod_stat armor_pierce (0..1) subtracts from the reduction.

Ranged special (Skillz, DESIGN §22): keeps engage_min..engage_max m (prefers preferred_range) from its target and lobs bile_glob (data/projectiles.json) at it. Spit = Desi's Spit clip: spit_windup s telegraph (sac + mouth glow, gallspitter_windup), release at the clip's 'release' marker (else spit_windup), spit_recovery s, then spit_cooldown s +/- cooldown_jitter. Aim: the target's feet + aim_height m, no lead, aim_spread m random error at engage_max (per-zombie seeded RNG), so a player who keeps moving is never hit and a camper is. Direct hit = contact_damage x glob_damage_mult (contact_damage is already x damage_mult 0.5: weak in melee). Targeting (host only, every retarget s): a player who stayed within camp_radius m for camp_seconds s gets +camp_priority, one melee zombies can't path to (a perch / pit) +unreachable_priority, the current target +stickiness, minus 1 per metre. Standpoints: rings around the target scored for line of sight, a clear lob arc, travel (path) cost, high ground (elevation_weight per m above the target) and spread from other Gallspitters (spread_radius m); relocates after spits_per_spot spits. Rushed (target within retreat_range m): backs off to a farther standpoint at retreat_speed_mult; cornered inside attack_range it swipes. A hit of >= stagger_frac x max_health during the windup cancels the spit (Hit clip). stuck_window s / stuck_min m: own stuck check while walking to a standpoint (repick, then ZombieNav chase for fallback_chase s).
